## Final Accepted Amendments

### `fr-2-965c5a37`

In check_param_range (provenance.rs:116-127), NaN values silently pass the range check because IEEE 754 comparisons with NaN always return false. Add a !value.is_finite() guard that produces a RangeWarning (or a distinct diagnostic) when the value is NaN or infinity, and add a test for this edge case.

### `fr-2-0f26a053`

The preset-level Provenance struct (presets.rs:14-19) uses confidence: Option<String>, allowing arbitrary strings like 'medium' (present in shipped TOML files default.toml:99 and soft_acidic.toml:23). The per-parameter ParamMeta uses the validated ConfidenceLevel enum. Either: (a) change Provenance.confidence to Option<ConfidenceLevel> and update the shipped TOML files to use valid enum values, or (b) document the intentional difference and add a note explaining that preset-level confidence is freeform while per-parameter confidence is validated.

### `fr-2-b6ef0732`

Add validation that valid_range[0] <= valid_range[1] during deserialization or in check_param_range. An inverted range like [5.0, 0.1] would cause every value to trigger a spurious warning. A simple assertion or early return with a descriptive warning would prevent silent misconfiguration.

### `fr-2-e1a4e39a`

Normalize provenance display/range-check values for legacy total-style process parameters before feeding them to `format_param()` / `check_ranges()` (`crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:400-509`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/provenance.rs:148-158`). Several of the parameters being documented are explicitly stored in legacy total units and converted by the runtime to concentration units (`crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:56-63`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:72-109`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:169-174`). Right now a value like `aob_k_tan_mg = 0.5` is displayed and range-checked as `0.5 mg N/L`, even though the engine actually uses `0.025 mg N/L`, so the new provenance output and `valid_range` diagnostics are scientifically wrong for these fields.

### `fr-2-50ee4385`

Add a provenance path for the active code-defined process defaults that are still hardcoded during scenario materialization. `ProcessParams` includes `death_biomass_to_detritus_fraction` and the microfauna routing fractions (`crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:211-247`), but `ProcessParamsPreset` has no fields/`param_meta` support for them and rejects unknown metadata keys (`crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:351-388`, `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:392-500`, `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:723-731`). `process_preset_to_params()` then injects literal values for them (`crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:433-443`) and drops provenance entirely. Those runtime parameters still cannot carry source/confidence/range metadata.
